expected.message:
These EKS principals assume roles that provide bind, escalate and impersonate permissions. 

The `bind` permission allows users to create bindings to roles with rights they do not already have. The `escalate` permission allows users effectively escalate their privileges. The `impersonate` permission allows users to impersonate and gain the rights of other users in the cluster. Running containers with these permissions has the potential to effectively allow privilege escalation to the cluster-admin level.

source_rules.description:
These EKS principals assume roles that provide bind, escalate and impersonate permissions. 

The `bind` permission allows users to create bindings to roles with rights they do not already have. The `escalate` permission allows users effectively escalate their privileges. The `impersonate` permission allows users to impersonate and gain the rights of other users in the cluster. Running containers with these permissions has the potential to effectively allow privilege escalation to the cluster-admin level.
source_rules.name: EKS principals assume roles that provide bind, escalate and impersonate permissions
source_rules.resolution_recommendation: To follow the principle of least privilege and minimize the risk of unauthorized access and data breaches, it is recommended not to grant `bind`, `escalate` or `impersonate` permissions.
